newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had raised its overnight borrowing rate to 12.5 percent from 11.5 percent.
The bank also raised its overnight lending rate to 14.5 percent from 13.5.
Traders said the move was meant to curb speculation in the foreign exchange market after a fall in treasury note rates in Monday's auction.
Traders said they had expected this morning's rise in the overnight rates.
"The Central Bank indicated it was planning to increase again its overnight rates after it offered one-day repos of 12.5 percent on borrowing and 14.5 percent on lending on Tuesday," said one trader.
